items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 11:47am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There's a Severe Gale Warning in operation, soon becoming a Gale Warning this afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Very deep low (Storm Boelo) near northern Scotland, slowly moving towards southern Norway.


##Wind##

West 7 to severe gale 9, decreasing 5 to 7, then backing south or southwest 4 or 5 later, then south or southeast 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough becoming moderate or rough, then slight or moderate for a time later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain spreading in later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 to 7, veering south or southwest 6 to gale 8.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming rough or very rough for a time.


##Weather##

Rain at times, showers later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, becoming moderate or poor in rain.
